title: Python for AWS
pageTitle: Python for AWS — learn Python and boto3 with real AWS tasks
description: Learn Python by doing the jobs IT teams really ask for: automate a weekly spreadsheet report, find what's on the AWS bill, alert before a certificate expires, process uploads with Lambda and DynamoDB, summarize support tickets with a foundation model on Amazon Bedrock, and test your code before it ships. Practice in your browser, then build it on your own AWS account.
